title: Task Scheduler
statement_md:
Tasks are single letters. Identical tasks need at least n units of time between them. Idle time is allowed. Return the least number of time units needed to run all tasks.

**Function:** `leastInterval(tasks, n)`

**Input:** one JSON value per parameter, in the order above. **Output:** the returned value as JSON.
hints: Ask which choice is safe to make right now and never needs to be undone.
Sorting by the right key often reveals the greedy order.
Data structure: a sorted list, or a heap (heapq) to repeatedly get the smallest or largest item.
